carrier.description: positive row-stochastic Markov operator with coordinate sectors

operator_constraints: every row sum of E is zero
P+E remains nonnegative on the retained sweep

stability_bound.localized: ||Q'_i P' Q'_j-Q_i P Q_j||_F <= ||Delta_i P Q'_j||_F+||Q'_i E Q'_j||_F+||Q_i P Delta_j||_F

block_activity_policy.meaning: operator block-strength diagnostic, not Markov positive support

markov_positive_support_policy.meaning: strictly positive transition entries above numerical tolerance

negative_boundaries: The block-activity threshold is not the Markov positive-support threshold.
A rotated Hilbert sector frame is not a set-valued Markov state partition.
The probability diagnostics concern the state-level kernel only.
Block stability does not imply spectral or pseudospectral stability for a nonnormal operator.
UNRESOLVED is a margin status, not an exact-zero or exact-nonzero claim.
This finite sweep is not a universal Markov robustness theorem.
